purpose: A single durable Gemini development work unit with repeated bounded Plan→Evidence→Implement→Test→Repair loops, one integrated candidate and one independent review.

loop_steps.name: inspect_and_prioritize
loop_steps.action: Read previous checkpoint, failed tests, unresolved highest-impact evidence gap and fixed baseline; select next bounded in-scope improvement

loop_steps.name: source_and_oracle
loop_steps.action: Record evidence grade and expected observable pass/fail oracle before edit. UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN

loop_steps.name: implement
loop_steps.action: Extend permitted src/vae + fixture/test + run docs; reuse existing Native/Reader read-only interface instead of creating parallel infrastructure

loop_steps.name: cheap_verify
loop_steps.action: Run direct offline/unit/fixture/contract checks plus read-only access tests if genuinely permitted; capture command and exit code

loop_steps.name: repair_or_defer
loop_steps.action: Fix failure introduced by same task and rerun only affected tests; record blocked facts when outside safe scope

loop_steps.name: checkpoint_and_repeat
loop_steps.action: Update single task progress ledger with SHA, evidence, net improvement, accepted defects, remaining risks, next priority; commit within task branch; repeat if meaningful scoped improvement remains

work_tracks_within_same_task.required: Source coverage and gaps for live mode/profile, USER/CPU, dual normalize, game/Calendar, coach, GM, player, match observations, safe backup; no false live claims
work_tracks_within_same_task.priority: P0 for G01–G03 and safety, then G04–G08 as evidence permits

work_tracks_within_same_task.required: Fix reviewed F02/F03/F07, clarify F04 event ids/corrections, F05 test oracles; R06 comparison context and R08 NOT_RUN initial semantics

A runnable offline/dry-run path ProfileSnapshot→Diagnosis→TrialPreflight→ExecutionReceipt(NOT_RUN)→Readback(UNVERIFIED)→Observation(INCONCLUSIVE)→Evaluation→Revision(PENDING)→DFeedback; E1 initial thin slice, E2–E4 contracts and extension tests
work_tracks_within_same_task.priority: Actual reusable code with fixtures, not just reports

work_tracks_within_same_task.required: Only read UI/files and pre-existing read-only tools under actual authority; avoid process attach, hook, elevation, save operations unless separately confirmed
work_tracks_within_same_task.priority: Runtime facts only where safety preflight passes

continuation_rule: Continue within same task and branch when work is within allowlist and a measurable test failure/evidence gap remains solvable. Do not require Human every local fix. No fixed number of rounds; no unbounded repetition without progress.
on_stall: Record exact blocker, negative evidence and next owner. Remain candidate_pending_validation or deferred, never claim PASS.
when_review_ready: Produce one complete integrated release candidate, frozen manifest, full focused regression, no P0 in-scope implementable defects, all important unknowns bounded, and one completion pointer. Do not self-accept.
human_checkpoint_policy: Use existing workflow stage plan/completion checkpoints where applicable; no repeated micro-approvals for within-scope edits; game writes and protected actions require distinct Human decision.

review_policy.reviewer: new isolated GPT independent_review fork from NBA_COMMON_BASELINE_READY
review_policy.review_frequency: one concentrated audit after integrated candidate, focused follow-up only for material findings
